name: The Great Nothing
description: The southern deserts are extremely dangerous, with enormous sandworms hunting in the dunes, giant scorpions foraging for food, and lamias claiming ancient ruins as their lairs. The mountains to the south harbor fierce barbarian tribes who traverse the desert for annual raids; they brave the sands, which serve as a natural defense against any incursions on their villages, to pillage the towns to the north and other barbarian tribes of the near regions. Many legends permeate the desert, but the most renowned speaks of an oasis whose waters can transmute metal into gold, heal any curse or ailment, and even resurrect the deceased. Countless adventurers seek this miraculous site annually, yet the oasis eludes discovery, its precise location and true capabilities eluding explorers. In reality, the oasis does exist but proves elusive, as a mystical sandstorm envelops it every three dawns, transporting it to a new location in the desert. The vigilant guardianship of numerous sphinxes further complicates access. These guardians consider it their sacred duty to protect the waters, permitting only those they judge as worthy. They challenge aspirants with questions to gauge their righteousness, tasks to measure their courage and integrity, and riddles to test their wisdom. Those failing the tests are turned away, and any who dare to approach the waters without consent are met with lethal consequences. Some scholars believe the oasis was created by drops of blood from the gods; others think it is a tear of Tamera or that it holds an artifact left by the angels. The truth is only known to the sphinxes, but they never disclosed it while seemingly waiting for something or someone and allowing very few to use its water’s power.
